name: CVE
description: The authoritative source for CVE identifiers. Every public vulnerability gets a CVE ID here.

name: National Vulnerability Database
description: Enriches CVE entries with CVSS scores, CWE tags, CPE data and fix info. The most widely used reference.

name: Open Source Vulnerabilities
description: Focuses on open source packages with precise version ranges.

name: GitHub Advisory Database
description: Security advisories for open source packages, tightly integrated with Dependabot.

name: Global CVE (GCVE) Database
description: Open advisory database from the decentralized Global CVE (GCVE) initiative, launched in 2026. Correlates data from 25+ public sources.

name: VulDB
description: Community-driven database with detailed timelines and CVSS scores. Free tier available.

name: Exploit Database
description: Archive of public exploits and PoC code, maintained by OffSec (the team behind Kali Linux). Searchable offline with SearchSploit.

name: Rapid7 Vulnerability and Exploit Database
description: Vulnerability and exploit data from Rapid7, used in Metasploit.

name: Vulners
description: Aggregator indexing CVE, exploits, advisories and vendor bulletins in one search.

name: Packet Storm
description: Long-running archive of advisories, exploits and security tools.

name: Snyk Vulnerability Database
description: Deep coverage of open source package vulnerabilities with remediation guidance.

name: Tenable CVE Database
description: CVE details enriched with Tenable severity ratings and plugin coverage.

name: OpenVAS Greenbone Community Feed
description: Greenbone Community Feed with Network Vulnerability Tests (NVTs) used by the OpenVAS scanner.

name: Zero Day Initiative
description: Coordinated disclosure program. Publishes advisories once the vendor has patched, or as 0-days when the vendor misses the deadline.

name: CERT Coordination Center
description: Vulnerability notes from one of the oldest CERT organizations.

name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
description: Definitive list of CVEs actively exploited in the wild. Mandatory patching reference for US federal agencies.

name: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
description: Canada's national cyber security authority. Alerts and advisories on actively exploited and critical vulnerabilities.

name: ENISA European Union Vulnerability Database
description: European Union Vulnerability Database, run by ENISA under the NIS2 Directive. Launched in May 2025; every entry gets an EUVD ID alongside its CVE ID.

name: CERT-EU
description: Security advisories for EU institutions, bodies and agencies.

name: BSI - Federal Office for Information Security
description: Germany Federal Office for Information Security. Advisories in German and English.

name: CERT-FR / ANSSI
description: France's national cybersecurity agency. High-quality advisories (avis) and alerts, published in French.

name: CERT-SE
description: Sweden's national CSIRT, part of the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) at FRA since July 2026 (previously MSB).

name: NCSC Netherlands
description: Dutch National Cyber Security Centre. Known for detailed enterprise software advisories.

name: NCSC United Kingdom
description: UK National Cyber Security Centre vulnerability guidance and alerts.

name: China National Vulnerability Database
description: China national vulnerability database, run by the Ministry of State Security.

name: China National Vulnerability Database CNCERT
description: Complementary to CNNVD, run by CNCERT/CC under the Ministry of Industry and IT.

name: Japan Vulnerability Notes
description: Japan coordinated disclosure portal covering Japan-origin software.

name: JVN iPedia
description: Japan enriched CVE database with Japanese product coverage and translations.

name: Australian Cyber Security Centre
description: Australian Cyber Security Centre advisories and alerts.

name: CISA ICS Advisories
description: Advisories for Industrial Control Systems - critical infrastructure, SCADA, PLCs.

name: ICS-CERT
description: The original ICS-CERT portal, now merged into CISA. Historical archive of ICS vulnerability reports.

name: Microsoft Security Response Center
description: Microsoft Patch Tuesday updates and out-of-band security advisories.

name: Red Hat Security Advisories
description: CVE tracking for RHEL, OpenShift, OpenStack with errata and fix status.

name: Debian Security Bug Tracker
description: Real-time tracking of CVE status across all Debian packages and releases.

name: Ubuntu Security Notices
description: USN advisories for all supported Ubuntu releases.

name: Android Security Bulletins
description: Monthly security bulletins for Android OS and Pixel devices.

name: Apple Security Updates
description: Security content for iOS, macOS, Safari and other Apple products.

name: Cisco PSIRT
description: Cisco Product Security Incident Response Team advisories.

name: Oracle Critical Patch Update
description: Oracle quarterly advisories covering all Oracle products.

name: Full Disclosure
description: The original public security disclosure mailing list. Unfiltered, high signal.

name: oss-security
description: Coordinated disclosure for open source software. Patches often posted before CVE assignment.

name: NVD JSON API
description: NIST's official CVE API (2.0) with filtering and pagination. A free API key raises the rate limit.

name: OSV API
description: Google's OSV REST API - query by package, version or commit hash.

name: CISA KEV JSON
description: Machine-readable version of the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

name: Exploit Prediction Scoring System
description: FIRST's Exploit Prediction Scoring System - a daily score for how likely a CVE is to be exploited in the next 30 days.
